entry.title: New: Bill 140 (Hawaiʻi County) — Passed Second Reading
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 25-45, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2026 Appropriates revenues in the following accounts: Housing Choice Voucher – Dolphin Bay ($23,912), Dolphin Bay Rent
